implementation: Core depends on rune-platform and retains one chooser. Ui and Store contain metadata and tokens only; the Core service owns descriptors, immutable bytes and payload commands.

One fixed preparation worker validates identity, size, mtime and ctime before/after a bounded read with EOF check. Retries retain the same bytes and logical nonce and never reopen a path or fall back to text-only.
A shared 32 MiB/eight-entry lease is attached to Bytes::from_owner and survives clones/slices. The work queue has eight slots; UI never waits for capacity.

Account, channel, permission, generation, request and deadline fences guard dispatch. Disconnect invalidates attempts but retains prepared files; account change or channel revocation discards their grants.

Progress is projected once through Event::UploadProgress. Completion requires a matching valid remote file acknowledgement; malformed metadata becomes ambiguous, foreign nonce collisions remain uncorrelated incoming messages, and structural local deliveries are never relabelled remote.

Explicit retries retain frozen body/reply/files. Definitive same-attempt failures can refine Unknown, and a valid late acknowledgement can confirm the same logical send after cancellation without consuming a newer draft.

Cancelled preparation is drained on completion even without another pick. Client close invalidates lightweight controls and transfers runtime shutdown to one named thread per Client; payload receivers are not drained on UI.
Channel/server removal clears pending attachment metadata through the canonical Store cleanup; regression preserves other channels and prevents resurrection after Ready.

regressions.red: Upload suite exposed restored-mtime ctime change, malformed cancelled ACK, foreign nonce collision, text omitted from message budget and missing reply-history guard.
regressions.green: Selection ctime check, scoped ACK normalization, text+file budget and READ_HISTORY revalidation. A complete valid late ACK intentionally confirms the same logical send after cancel.

regressions.red: Definitive failure for the same cancelled attempt could not refine Unknown.

limits: Mock limits are one file, 20 MiB/file and 25 MiB/message including text; they are simulation policy, not verified Discord upload limits. Core retains at most 32 MiB/eight prepared entries.
Only single-file Linux selection and Mock send are integrated. Multiple files, drag/drop, file paste and real provider transport remain pending; full 07 and 08 checkboxes remain open.
Real adapters keep uploads disabled. No authenticated upload, real-account read confirmation or invitation acceptance was enabled or performed.
The two images verify the shown limn state for owned fixtures. They do not prove remote delivery, all geometries, physical input or screen-reader behavior.
Prepared files live only in RAM and do not survive restart. The immutable bytes, not a reopened path, are retained for explicit retry.
Linux filesystem calls already in flight cannot be forcibly cancelled; one retained fixed worker is drained on completion. Runtime shutdown or OS thread exhaustion limits cleanup guarantees.

Normal Client shutdown uses one shutdown thread per Client, not one per file. If thread creation fails, Tokio nonwaiting shutdown is the fallback; the normal last-destructor-thread guarantee does not extend to that resource-exhaustion case.
Wayland currently has no exported xdg_foreign parent; the picker is unparented. No Windows/macOS picker or modality claim is made.

REA inherits unrecorded caller environment (ambient_environment unknown), samples processes and snapshots opt-in files; it does not trace all network/filesystem syscalls. Prelaunch hashing and unchanged path metadata are not atomic proof of the launched OS image.
The current acknowledgement validates file metadata and identity, not a remote content hash or byte-for-byte text equality. The eventual real adapter needs its own transport fixtures and contract.
